source.title: Official American Thoracic Society/Japanese Respiratory Society Clinical Practice Guidelines: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis Diagnosis and Management.

whyItFits: Open abstract of the ATS/JRS LAM guideline. The PMC XML has no recommendation body, so only statements in the abstract are used.
limitations: Abstract only. The PMC XML has no body, so doses and VEGF-D thresholds were not written.
